run_resize_mask: run resize_mask to decode COCO RLE masks, resize to original shape, and re-encode with updated area and bbox
run_interpolate_masks: run the script to interpolate extracted masks across splits using multiprocessing with 60 worker processes
review_resize_mask: review resize_mask to understand how it decodes RLE segmentation, resizes with nearest-neighbor interpolation, and re-encodes
refactor_resize_mask: refactor resize_mask to accept configurable interpolation method instead of hardcoded INTER_NEAREST
summarize_resize_mask: summarize resize_mask which processes COCO annotation segmentation masks by resizing them to original image dimensions
